# Website Monitor

> Open source tool that runs 53 checks against a website (TLS, security headers, performance, SEO, DNS, privacy, accessibility) from a web UI, a REST API, or a scheduled job that writes a Markdown report.

Each check returns a verdict: pass, warning, fail, or no verdict when it cannot decide (an error, a timeout, a missing API key). The API is a FastAPI application; the web UI is a static page that calls it. Source and documentation: https://github.com/fabriziosalmi/websites-monitor (MIT license).

## Links

- Web UI (static, needs a running API set in Settings): https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/websites-monitor/
- API reference: https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/websites-monitor/swagger.html
- OpenAPI description: https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/websites-monitor/openapi.json
- Docker instructions: https://github.com/fabriziosalmi/websites-monitor/blob/main/docs/DOCKER.md
- Container image: ghcr.io/fabriziosalmi/websites-monitor

## API

- GET /health: status, version and number of checks.
- GET /checks: the checks, with ID, category and description.
- POST /monitor/single with {"website": "example.com", "checks": ["ssl_cert", "hsts"]}: runs the listed checks against one site.
- GET /check/{id}?website=example.com: runs one check.
- POST /monitor, POST /monitor/async, POST /generate-report: every check against a list of sites.

Each result has a verdict (pass, warn, fail, unknown) and a detail; a scan also returns a summary.

## Command line and MCP

- Command line: `python -m websites_monitor scan example.com --json` (or `websites-monitor` in the Docker image) returns the same JSON as the REST API. `--fail-on fail` makes it exit 1 when a check fails.
- MCP server for AI assistants: `python -m websites_monitor mcp` (stdio) or `--transport streamable-http`. Tools: health, list_checks, run_check, scan, scan_many, report, with the same JSON as the REST API.

## Checks

### Security (10)

- `ssl_cert` (SSL certificate): Validity and days to expiry
- `ssl_cipher_strength` (TLS cipher strength): Negotiated cipher suite
- `security_headers` (Security headers): CSP, X-Frame-Options and others
- `hsts` (HSTS): Strict-Transport-Security header
- `xss_protection` (XSS protection): X-XSS-Protection header
- `cors_headers` (CORS policy): Cross-origin response headers
- `mixed_content` (Mixed content): HTTP resources on HTTPS pages
- `subresource_integrity` (Subresource integrity): SRI on external scripts and styles
- `rate_limiting` (Rate limiting): Response to a burst of requests
- `data_leakage` (Data leakage): Mentions in public GitHub code

### Performance (8)

- `pagespeed_performances` (PageSpeed score): Google PageSpeed Insights
- `website_load_time` (Load time): Total time to load the page
- `server_response_time` (Server response time): Time to first byte
- `brotli_compression` (Brotli compression): Content-Encoding: br
- `asset_minification` (Asset minification): CSS and JavaScript minified
- `cdn` (CDN): Content delivery network in front
- `redirect_chains` (Redirect chains): Number of hops to the final URL
- `redirects` (HTTPS redirect): HTTP redirects to HTTPS

### SEO and content (9)

- `sitemap` (Sitemap): sitemap.xml present and valid
- `robot_txt` (robots.txt): Present and well formed
- `open_graph_protocol` (Open Graph tags): Social sharing metadata
- `alt_tags` (Image alt text): Every image has an alt attribute
- `semantic_markup` (Semantic markup): Structured data in the page
- `url_canonicalization` (Canonical URL): rel="canonical" link
- `favicon` (Favicon): Site icon present
- `broken_links` (Broken links): Internal links that fail
- `external_links` (External links): Outbound links reachable

### Domain and DNS (7)

- `domain_expiration` (Domain expiration): Registration expiry date
- `dnssec` (DNSSEC): Signed DNS zone
- `dns_blacklist` (DNS blocklists): Listed on DNS-based blocklists
- `domain_breach` (Breach exposure): Domain in known data breaches
- `domainsblacklists_blacklist` (Domain blocklists): Aggregated threat lists
- `subdomain_enumeration` (Subdomains): Common subdomains that resolve
- `email_domain` (Email records): SPF and mail records

### Privacy and tracking (10)

- `cookie_policy` (Cookie policy): Policy page linked
- `cookie_flags` (Cookie flags): Secure and HttpOnly set
- `cookie_duration` (Cookie duration): Session cookie lifetimes
- `cookie_samesite_attribute` (Cookie SameSite): SameSite attribute set
- `ad_and_tracking` (Ads and tracking): Analytics and ad scripts
- `floc` (FLoC opt-out): interest-cohort permission policy
- `privacy_exposure` (Privacy exposure): Sensitive data in the page
- `privacy_protected_whois` (WHOIS privacy): Registrant data redacted
- `third_party_requests` (Third-party requests): Requests to other domains
- `third_party_resources` (Third-party resources): Scripts and styles from other domains

### Accessibility and mobile (5)

- `accessibility` (Accessibility): Accessibility score
- `mobile_friendly` (Mobile friendly): Viewport and responsive layout
- `amp_compatibility` (AMP): AMP version available
- `internationalization` (Internationalization): lang and hreflang attributes
- `browser_compatibility` (Browser compatibility): Markup older browsers handle

### Technical (4)

- `content_type_headers` (Content-Type header): MIME type and charset
- `cms_used` (CMS detection): Platform behind the site
- `clientside_rendering` (Client-side rendering): Content rendered by JavaScript
- `deprecated_libraries` (Deprecated libraries): Outdated JavaScript libraries
